desc:
Etsy product photo plans and mockups show you exactly which images each listing needs and how to take or build them. Ecom Swift LLC prepares shot lists, mockup layouts and image order for your Etsy items, so every photo slot does a job.

## What is an Etsy photo plan?

An Etsy photo plan is a written guide for the images of a listing. It tells you what to shoot, from which angle, on what background and in which order the pictures should appear. For sellers of digital or print-on-demand items it can also include mockups, which are images that place your artwork on a mug, frame, shirt or wall.

Ecom Swift LLC writes the plan around your products and your phone camera, so you do not need a studio to follow it.

## Why photos decide so much on Etsy

Shoppers cannot touch what they buy. They scroll through small thumbnails and judge each item in a moment. The first image has to stand out in a grid, and the others have to answer the questions that remain: how big is it, what does it look like up close, how is it used, how does it arrive.

Many shops use only two or three of the ten image slots. That leaves questions unanswered and forces buyers to send messages or leave. Others use ten photos that all show the same angle, which adds no information.

## How a photo plan improves results

Strong images help in three ways. A clear thumbnail earns the click. A set of detail, scale and in-use shots builds confidence. A final image that covers shipping, sizing or personalization saves the buyer a question. Together these reduce doubt, and less doubt supports more orders.

Planning also saves effort. A shot list lets you photograph a whole batch in one sitting, with the same light and background, so the shop looks consistent. Photos affect many things beyond our work, such as price and competition, so we describe the improvements and do not promise results.

## What a good photo plan includes

- A thumbnail shot designed to read well at small size and after Etsy's crop.
- A clear order for all ten photo slots.
- Detail shots of material, finish and craftsmanship.
- A scale shot using a hand, a coin or a ruler.
- In-use and lifestyle images that show the item in a real setting.
- A packaging image that shows what arrives.
- A size or options image that answers common questions.
- Lighting, background and prop tips that work with a phone.
- Mockup layouts and a size chart template in larger packages.

## What we do

We start by looking at your current photos and listings. Then we write a shot list for each product type, with notes on angle, crop and lighting. We explain how the ten-slot order works and which image should come first.

In the Standard package we also build one reusable mockup layout from your artwork, and sketch a size and scale image. Premium covers more product types, up to a set of finished mockup images, a branded size chart template and a plan for a short listing video. You take the photos and upload the images, or ask us to do the upload as an add-on step.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Use soft daylight near a window for most products.
- Keep the background simple and consistent.
- Show the item from several sides, plus a close view.
- Include something that shows real size.
- Check how the thumbnail looks on a phone.

**Avoid:**
- Using the same angle in all ten slots.
- Busy backgrounds that compete with the product.
- Heavy filters that change the real color.
- Text so small it cannot be read on a phone.
- Mockups that show an item you do not actually sell.

## Who this service is for

It suits a maker who photographs everything on a bedspread in the evening and wants a better method. It helps a digital product seller who needs clean mockups of printables, and a shop owner with a growing catalog who wants every new listing to follow the same photo structure.

## What we need from you

Send your current photos or listing links, a short description of your products and, for mockups, your artwork files. We do not need access to your shop for a plan, though a manager invitation with limited permissions helps if we are also checking live listings. We never ask for passwords.
